title: Support systems of a Zscaler cloud, and Feed Central

prose.text: Besides the Central Authority, the Service Edges and the Nanolog, each cloud runs supporting systems, and one separate cloud feeds them all. {{support-systems}}
{{encrypted-links}} Sandbox behavior is in [[zia.sandbox]], hosted PAC files in [[zia.traffic-forwarding.pac]], and Log Routers in [[shared.cloud-architecture.logging-path]].
What happens to classification while Feed Central is unreachable is open: [[shared.cloud-architecture.failure-domains]].

support-systems.statement: Each cloud has support systems and servers, including Sandbox servers (files selected for behavioral analysis are sent there and reports are stored), PAC file servers (hosting Zscaler PAC files and custom PAC files uploaded to Zscaler), the multi-tenant Zscaler Admin Console for policy management and reporting, and Log Routers.

quotes: Additionally, each cloud has various support systems and servers, including:
Sandbox servers, where files selected for behavioral analysis are sent for analysis and reports are stored.
PAC file servers, which host Zscaler PAC files and custom PAC files uploaded to Zscaler.
The Zscaler Admin Console, which provides an intuitive, multi-tenant interface for policy management and reporting.
Log Routers, which ensure logs for each organization are stored in the appropriate Nanolog cluster.

encrypted-links.statement: All components communicate with each other over an encrypted SSL/TLS tunnel.

quotes: All components communicate with each other over an encrypted SSL/TLS tunnel.

feed-central.statement: Zscaler Feed Central is a separate Zscaler cloud used solely for the centralized distribution of various feeds to the Zscaler clouds.

quotes: Zscaler Feed Central is a separate Zscaler cloud that is used solely for the centralized distribution of various feeds to the Zscaler clouds.

feed-partners.statement: Zscaler has partnerships with Microsoft, Google, RSA, Verisign and others for data feeds, including feeds for URL filtering, anti-virus definitions and IP reputation.

quotes: Zscaler has a number of partnerships with Microsoft, Google, RSA, Verisign, and others for getting data feeds, including feeds for URL filtering, anti-virus definitions, and IP reputation.

feed-path.statement: Feed Central distributes its threat intelligence and other feeds to the Central Authority, which sends updates to the Public Service Edges, so that every Public Service Edge has the latest URL database and malware and threat information.

quotes: Zscaler Feed Central distributes its threat intelligence and other feeds to the CA, which then sends updates to the Public Service Edges, ensuring that every Public Service Edge has the latest version of the URL database and the latest malware and threat information.
